responses.title: NT's Loft - East London Club & Terrace
responses.description: NT’s Loft is an intimate club and terrace overlooking the East London skyline. The space boasts an impressive dance floor, an upgraded Function- One sound system and an all-weather heated terrace with a retractable roof. Same location, same intimate charm. Bigger. Larger sound.

About Us

Tucked between Hackney and London Fields, our New York loft-style space is the perfect evening spot for cocktails, cold pints, and crisp, oven-baked pizzas. By night, the energy shifts as we transform into a vibrant club, hosting some of the city’s most exciting DJs across the dance music spectrum.

Just beyond the dancefloor, our terrace opens up to views over the city, providing a fitting backdrop for sunset drinks.

With a focus on sound, energy, and atmosphere, we’ve become a true home for East London’s nightlife.

360 TOUR THE VENUE
